audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 5 disagreed with both the packet chart and the mirror; in particular the first-item stage was given to Ornn while whys[5] on the same page says his crit items spike harder than your tank item.
audit.why: Mirror (graves__ornn) set both charts to Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Graves / Graves / Ornn with ratings 5,3,3,3,7,6,2 from the Graves side; the packet chart is identical.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 5 flipped as one atomic group across both layers; ratings inverted to 5,7,7,7,3,4,8.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold the first-item stage as Ornn's spike, and no cooldown was ever given for Quickdraw.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s but its cooldown is refunded by basic attacks, so a timer is the wrong thing to count. End of the Line is 13s at rank 1, Smoke Screen 26s.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why rewritten to the Graves-favoured item stage; the numbers and the auto-refund written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The magma pillar's terrain interaction was never stated in either direction.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar and carries the terrain flag; End of the Line 'detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain', so your own pillar detonates his shell early. The same pillar is the terrain Searing Charge collides with to produce the knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is described three times as a blind that shuts off your auto-Brittle procs.
audit.why: Riot's text: it creates a cloud that reduces sight range, with magic damage and a brief slow on the initial impact. Reduced sight is not a blind and does not stop attacks from landing. The mirror reached the same conclusion.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Buckshot' is used as the name of a Graves ability. He has no such ability in the kit file.
audit.why: His slots are New Destiny (P), End of the Line (Q), Smoke Screen (W), Quickdraw (E), Collateral Damage (R).
audit.corrected: Fixed in whys[2]; the same wrong name survives in early and mid.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Quickdraw's cooldown.
edits.after: His shotgun crit item lands before your tank item converts — hold the wave and farm to two items.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Graves Quickdraw: 16s at rank 1, but autos refund it — count his hits, not the clock. - End of the Line: 13s, and it detonates early on your magma pillar. - Smoke Screen: 26s at rank 1, slow plus sight reduction.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, but every auto he lands refunds it — watch his hits, not a timer.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Your magma pillar is terrain: End of the Line detonates on it early, and Searing Charge knocks up against it.

edits.before: At 3 your full E-into-Q-pillar combo plus W's percent-HP Brittle exhale out-trades his Buckshot and punishes any step-up.
edits.after: At 3 your full E-into-Q-pillar combo plus W's percent-HP Brittle exhale out-trades End of the Line and any step-up.

edits.before: Bait his Smoke Screen, then W-poke through it since unstoppable percent-HP damage doesn't care about the blind
edits.after: Bait his Smoke Screen, then W-poke through it — the smoke cuts sight range, and percent-HP damage does not miss

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen on himself to blind your auto-Brittle procs and walk away
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen on himself to cut your sight range and walk out of the trade

notes: 'Buckshot' also appears in early ('a fresh Buckshot') and mid ('reposition for a Buckshot'), and 'Smoke Screen blind' survives in whys[4], whys[5], spikes[2].text, mid. Those are long prose blocks needing a phrase-level pass inside the length band; the short fields carrying the same two errors are corrected here. Note that the pillar interaction cuts both ways — it detonates his Q early, which is good for you, but it is also the wall he can shell against; only the verified halves are written.
